C0735.title: Air Canada Insider Collusion Theft of 400 kg Gold
C0735.summary: On April 17, 2023, approximately 400 kilograms of gold and US$2.5 million in foreign currency arriving at Toronto Pearson International Airport from Zurich, Switzerland were stolen. Police investigation revealed an inside job involving two Air Canada employees who used an internal printer to forge an airway bill, enabling a suspect to drive a truck and collect the cargo with the fraudulent documen

references.title: Inside-Outside Collusion Steals 400 kg of Gold! Another Suspect in World's Sixth Largest Gold Heist Arrested
